claims_not_supported: no WaterLily time step, Simulation, force value or GridSDF GPU bridge qualification (W1g)
no CUDA/Enzyme reverse or custom adjoint capability
no v16 geometry behavior, FD gradient, topology or optimizer claim
no absolute, grid-independent, high-Re or full-vehicle downforce claim
claims_supported: the committed T4 environment pair instantiates on an explicitly selected Colab T4 runtime
CUDA.jl is functional on the T4 device and the WaterLily CUDA extension activates
CuArray and KernelAbstractions CUDA smoke operations pass

environment_base.note: the W0 CPU environment directory julia/CFDSDFWaterLily is byte-frozen; the T4 environment lives in julia/CFDSDFWaterLilyT4 with the same WaterLily pin plus CUDA.jl, resolved on the T4 runtime, so W0/W1/W2a CPU identities are not disturbed

fail_closed_rule: any failed gate stops the slice; no W2-T4 or W1g work may start from a failed W0b; a changed GPU identity, Julia/WaterLily/CUDA version or Manifest re-pins with a new registration

gates_registered_before_measurement.G0_targeted_runtime: the Colab runtime is explicitly GPU-selected and nvidia-smi reports an NVIDIA T4 device
gates_registered_before_measurement.G2_cuarray_smoke: CuArray allocation, host write, device read, broadcast and reduction match the CPU reference exactly for the registered integer-valued Float32 vectors
gates_registered_before_measurement.G3_ka_smoke: a KernelAbstractions @kernel over a CuArray produces the registered exact result after synchronize()
gates_registered_before_measurement.G4_waterlily_cuda_ext: Base.get_extension(WaterLily, :WaterLilyCUDAExt) is not nothing after using WaterLily, CUDA
gates_registered_before_measurement.G5_no_solver_step: the W0b procedure constructs no WaterLily.Simulation and calls no sim_step!/mom_step!
gates_registered_before_measurement.G6_identity: repo commit, Project.toml and Manifest.toml sha256, Julia/WaterLily/CUDA.jl versions, GPU name, UUID if exposed, compute capability, total VRAM, driver version, CUDA runtime/toolkit version are recorded
gates_registered_before_measurement.threshold_modification_rule: no gate modification after seeing a measurement; a failure is a fail-closed stop with no evidence written

provenance.run_media: Colab notebook session driven through the colab-mcp browser connection; outputs captured into work/sdf_native_w0b_t4_cuda_env_2026_09/

what_W0b_qualifies: the T4 CUDA backend environment identity (versions, driver, GPU, device memory)
CuArray and KernelAbstractions CUDA round-trip smoke
what_W0b_does_not_qualify: no CFD time step or force value
no GridSDF GPU-port (that is W1g, registered separately after W2-T4a)
no Manifest change for the CPU environments
